title: Digital Input
text: Configure general-purpose input/output pins as digital input, 1 output, {Data type} sets Data type of GPIO input; {GPIO Group} sets the gPIO pins you want to configure and {Sample time} sets the frequency at which block reads input pin. Values come from the instance.

params.name: GPIO Group
params.values: GPIO pins you want to configure GPIO0-GPIO7 (default) | GPIO8-GPIO15 GPIO16-GPIO23 …

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Frequency at which block reads input pin values -1 (default) | 0.1

params.name: Data type
params.values: Data type of GPIO input auto (default) | unit8 | double | single | int8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | boolean
